clips.title: The story
paras: Blackrock fire has sunk Foreman Oslow's tools in Lake Everstill. With Lakeshire under pressure, local hands must maintain its defenses, and the tools shipped from Goldshire are needed to rebuild the shattered bridge.

The Great Bridge no longer connects Lakeshire to Elwynn Forest. A replacement shipment of stonemasonry and carpentry tools came overland from Goldshire, but the wagons could not reach town. The crew loaded the supplies into a rowboat to cross Lake Everstill. A Blackrock orc catapult struck the boat, destroying it and sending Oslow's heavy ironbound toolbox to the lake floor.

Lake Everstill holds dangers below its surface. Aggressive murloc tribes prowl the shallows, while predatory threshers hunt in the murky depths. Foreman Oslow needs his tools to resume repairs on the bridge and keep Lakeshire from falling further into ruin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I could really use a hand here, friend. With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies. My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out. We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult. Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.
Retrieve my toolbox, friend, and I'll make it worth your while.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to find my tools?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent recovery, friend! I never thought I'd see these tools again.
